about: The chronicle turns to the Philistines and traces their kings to Samson's seed. It retells Samson's life from Judges in brief, adds Delilah as the mother of his child and Meksaba as the Philistine queen, and tells how their two sons are raised together until Meksaba's son is made king.

sentences.l: And-behold Philistines seed-of Samson they-will-reign over-them.
sentences.i: And behold, the Philistines: the seed of Samson will reign over them.
sentences.n: ወናሁ 'and behold' opens a new topic in the chronicle's list of foreign royal lines. ዘርአ is construct ('seed-of'), ዘርአ ሳምሶን 'the seed of Samson'. The sentence is compressed: ኢሎፍሊ stands first as topic, then the plural verb ይነግሡ 'they will reign' (imperfect, ይ- prefix; plural because ዘርአ is collective) with ላዕሌሆሙ 'over them'. The chapter's claim is that the Philistine kings descend from Samson (Judges 13-16); the son it gives him by Delilah, Menahem, is introduced below and is not found in Judges.

sentences.l: And-Samson-as-for from-12 sons-of Jacob seed-of Dan he son-of maidservant from-Jacob.
sentences.i: As for Samson, he is of the twelve sons of Jacob, of the seed of Dan, a son of a maidservant by Jacob.
sentences.n: Samson belonged to the tribe of Dan (Judges 13:2), so the text traces him to Dan, son of Jacob by Bilhah, Rachel's maidservant (Genesis 30:4-6): hence ወልደ አመት 'son-of maidservant' (ወልደ is construct, አመት its genitive). The phrase may describe Dan rather than Samson, who is a descendant, not a son: ደቂቀ ያዕቆብ names the line. እም፲ወ፪ is the preposition እም- 'from' joined to ፲ወ፪ '12' (spoken ዐሠርቱ ወክልኤቱ). The enclitic -ሰ on ወሰምሶንሰ marks a change of topic ('as for Samson'). Note the two spellings ሳምሶን and ሰምሶን in this chapter.

And-then she-bore-him; and-again he-appeared-to-her and-said-to-her: Do-not-lay-on a-razor upon his-head, and-let-him-not-eat meat, and-not wine, and-let-him-not-marry from-foreign creation, except from-my-kin(?) and-house-of his-father.
sentences.i: The angel of God appeared to her, to the mother of Samson, and said to her: 'Keep yourself from everything unclean, and do not go near anyone except your husband, for the one born of you will be a Nazirite, God's holy one, and he will be the savior of Israel from the hand of the Philistines.' Then she bore him. And the angel appeared to her again and said to her: 'Do not put a razor to his head. Let him eat no meat and drink no wine, and let him not marry from a foreign people, but only from his own kin (?) and his father's house.'
sentences.n: Retells Judges 13: the angel announces the birth (13:3-5) and the Nazirite vow (no razor, no wine). Two things differ from Judges and are worth noticing: meat is added to the prohibitions, and the bar on a foreign wife is put into the angel's mouth, which sets up his later fault. Grammar: አስተርአያ is the 3ms perfect አስተርአየ 'appeared' with -ኣ 'to her', anticipating the ለ- phrase ለእሙ ለሰምሶን 'to his mother, to Samson's' (ለ- marking the recipient; so also ወይቤላ 'and he said to her'). መልአከ is construct, 'angel-of God'. ኀበ ምትኪ 'to your husband' (ምት 'husband' + 2fs -ኪ); the commands ተዐቀቢ (tä-stem imperative), ኢትቅረቢ and ኢታዕርጊ are feminine singular, addressed to the mother. ዘይትወለድ 'he who is born' (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect of the tä-stem). ናዝራዊ Nazirite (Numbers 6). ቅዱሱ is ቅዱስ 'holy one' with -ሁ 'his', anticipating ለእግዚኣብሔር ('his holy one, God's'); መድኀኒቶሙ 'their savior' anticipates ለእስራኤል in the same way. ኢወይነ is ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + ወይነ 'wine' (accusative), the verb being carried over from ይብላዕ. ፈጥረት 'creation' is used for 'people, race' (?). ዘመዲ is read as ዘመድ 'kin'; its ending -ዲ is not the usual 1st-person -የ, so 'my kin' (the angel speaking of herself) is doubtful, and I give the sense 'his own kin' (?).

sentences.i: and he pulled down the upper part of their house (?) and killed seven hundred thousand of them. And in his lifetime he killed seven hundred and twenty thousand with iron, with stone, with a staff, and with the jawbone of a donkey,
sentences.n: Samson pulls down the temple (Judges 16:29-30) and earlier kills a thousand men with a donkey's jawbone (15:15-16). The numerals are written with ፼ (10,000): ፸፼ = 70 x 10,000 = 700,000, and ፸፼ ወ፪፼ = 700,000 and 20,000 = 720,000, where ወ is 'and' between numerals. Judges gives far smaller figures; the chronicle simply exaggerates. The text states both ፸፼ for the temple and ፸፼ for his lifetime, as printed; the second reads as a total of 720,000 (my reading, ?). መልዕልቶሙ is 'their upper part' (መልዕልት), taken here as the upper floor or roof. The enclitic -ሰ on ወበሕይወቱሰ sets his lifetime against his death. በ- is 'with/by means of' repeated before each instrument. መንከሰ is the construct of መንከስ 'jawbone' (?); አድግ 'ass'.

sentences.i: When Samson killed the king of the Philistines in the house together with his people, and died with him, Delilah returned to her sister Meksaba, the queen of the Philistines.
sentences.n: The text assumes that the man killed in the collapsing house (Judges 16:30) was the Philistine king, and names his widow Meksaba. ለንጉሠ: ለ- marks the object, doubling -ኦ 'him' on ቀተሎ. ወለሊሁኒ 'and he himself too' (ለሊሁ 'himself' + the enclitic -ኒ 'also'). ገብአት is the feminine perfect 'she returned'. ሕዝቡ 'his people' (ሕዝብ + ሁ). ንግሥተ is construct 'queen-of'.

sentences.l: For both-of-them barren(?) they, and-none-to-them children, but pregnant there six months Meksaba, since she-conceived from Qolason, king-of Philistines, and-Delilah 4 months they, since she-conceived from Samson, and-died their-husbands.
sentences.i: Both women were barren (?) and had no children, but at that time Meksaba was six months pregnant by Qolason, king of the Philistines, and Delilah four months pregnant by Samson; and their husbands had died.
sentences.n: ላሕያት is read as the feminine plural of ላሕይ 'barren' (?); the sense is unsure, since the next clause ('and they had no children') says the same thing, so another sense of the word (for instance 'fair') may be meant, to be settled against Dillmann. The Philistine king's name ቈላሶን (Qolason) is a name from this tradition, not a biblical name. I read ህየ as 'there / at that time' (?). ፅኑሳት is feminine plural 'pregnant (ones)'. The text writes six as ስድስቱ አውራኅ but Delilah's four months as the numeral ፬ ፡ አውራኅ (spoken አርባዕቱ አውራኅ, አውራኅ being masculine); እሙንቱ 'they (are)' picks up the masculine word አውራኅ 'months'. እምዘ 'since, from the time that'. አምታቲሆን 'their husbands': አምታት is the plural of ምት 'husband' (as in ምትኪ above) with -ሆን '3fp their'.

sentences.l: And-they-loved-each-other exceedingly, and-their-love-also not as sisters but as mother to-her-child and-as child to-mother, likewise their-love;
sentences.i: They loved each other greatly, and their love was not that of sisters, but as a mother loves her child and a child its mother: so was their love.
sentences.n: ይትፋቀራ is the reciprocal tä-stem (ተፋቀረ) 'love one another', 3fp imperfect (Geʿez has no dual; the ending marks two women). ፍ ፡ ቅሮን is printed in the packet as two words; it is ፍቅሮን 'their love' (ፍቅር + -ሆን) and is kept as printed. አኮ 'not' negates a noun predicate; ከመ ... አላ ከመ 'not as ... but as'. ሕፃና is ሕፃን 'child' with the 3fs suffix, 'her child' (as in እኅታ 'her sister'), after ለ-. ከማሁ 'likewise' answers ከመ. The enclitic -ሂ in ወፍቅሮንሂ is 'and ... also'.

sentences.i: The two lived together, and the kingdom was in the hand of Meksaba, among those who survived the slaughter by Samson in the king's house.
sentences.n: ነበራ is the 3fp perfect of ነበረ 'to sit, dwell' (Geʿez has no dual; two women). ውስተ እዴሃ ለመክሳባ 'in her hand, Meksaba's' is the standard Geʿez way of showing possession by repeating the owner with ለ- (as with ለእሙ ለሰምሶን 'to his mother, to Samson's' above). መንግሥት here is 'kingdom, rule'; the enclitic -ሰ marks the topic. እምእለ ተርፉ 'from among those who survived' (partitive እም-). ቀትለ is construct 'slaying-of'; it names Samson as the slayer. ቤተ ንጉሥ 'house-of king' is a construct chain.

sentences.i: For none was left of the mighty men (?) of the Philistine kingdom; and so Meksaba reigned over the survivors.
sentences.n: Construct chain: ደቂቀ ኀይለ መንግሥተ ኢሎፍሊ, literally 'sons-of strength-of kingdom-of Philistines'. ደቂቀ ኀይል 'sons of strength' is a Semitic idiom for 'men of might, warriors' (compare Hebrew bene hayil), so I read 'the warriors of the Philistine kingdom' (?). ነግሠት is the feminine perfect 'she reigned', a woman ruling in her own right, a theme the chronicle returns to (compare the Queen of Sheba). ዘተርፈ is a relative clause on አልቦ 'there is not'; ተርፉ is the plural perfect 'they survived'.

sentences.n: ዳጎን is Dagon, the chief god of the Philistines (Judges 16:23; 1 Samuel 5), shown here as the people's lord and god (እግዚእነ, አምላክነ). ለእመ አሠነየ 'if he does well/prospers' (አሠነየ, causative 'make good'), with ለነ 'to us'. ይከውን is the imperfect 'it will be' (the jussive would be ይኩን); its subject is ዘውስተ ከርሥኪ 'that which is in your womb' and ወልደ 'a son' is the predicate accusative. ዘያነሥኦ ለአምላክነ means 'who will raise up our god' (አንሥአ, causative 'raise'; -ኦ 'him' doubled by ለአምላክነ), i.e. honour or restore his worship. sentences.i: They made the son of Meksaba king on his father's throne over the Philistines.
sentences.n: The Philistines make Meksaba's son king (Delilah's son Menahem is not enthroned here). ወረሰይዎ ንጉሠ ለወልደ መክሳባ 'they made him king, the son of Meksaba' (ረሰየ 'to make, set', 3mp + -ኦ, ንጉሠ the predicate, ለ- doubling the suffix). መንበረ is construct 'throne-of', ወልደ መክሳባ 'son-of Meksaba' likewise. The four ፨ close the part.

morph.gloss: and they made him, set him (ወ- + 3mp perfect + -ኦ '3ms him'; takes a predicate accusative 'as, to be')
king (accusative) · also construct 'king of' (ንጉሠ ሮምሂ 'the king of Rome too') · predicate accusative 'as king' (ዘይከውን ንጉሠ 'who will be king'; ይኩነነ ንጉሠ 'may he be king for us')
the son of (ለ- marking the object + noun, construct) · to the son of (ለ- 'to', dative, parallel to ለንጉሥ: ሀቦ ... ለወልደ ንጉሥ 'give ... to the king's son')
Meksaba (proper name; the Philistine queen in this tradition)

in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors') · upon, on (ውስተ ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'upon their hips'; ውስተ መንበረ አቡሁ 'on his father's throne')
throne of (noun, construct)
his father (+ -hu)
upon, over, against (preposition)
foreigners, Philistines (noun, collective; Psalm 87:4)

glossary.ክሳውዲሆሙ: ክሳድ — their necks (noun, plural ክሳውድ + -ሆሙ '3mp their')
glossary.ኮነ: ኮነ — he became, was (3m sg perfect, k-w-n) · 3ms form used here where 'we became' is meant (እንዘ ጠቢባን ኮነ አብዳነ; 1cp would be ኮንነ; sic) · 'if it is' after ለእመ (ወለእመ ኮነ ተባዕተ 'and if it is male'); impersonal 'when it was to him' of years (ሶበ ኮነ ሎቱ ፳ወ፪ ዓመተ 'when he was twenty-two') · 3ms form before a plural subject (ኮነ መዋዕሊሁ ፷ 'his days were sixty'); 'there was' (ኮነ ረኃብ 'there was a famine')
glossary.ኮነት: ኮነ — become, be (3fs perfect; subject መንግሥተ) · 'if it is' after እመ, the subject the unborn child (ወእመሂ ኮነት ወለተ 'and if it is a daughter')
glossary.ኵሎሙ: ኵሉ — all of them (+ -omu) · before a noun, 'all' (ኵሎሙ አድያመ ኢትዮጵያ 'all the regions of Ethiopia', ch. 55)
glossary.ወሀቦ: ወሀበ — he gave him (3ms perfect + -ኦ 3ms object) · with the -ኦ anticipating a ለ- phrase (ወሀቦ ለወልዱ 'he gave him, to his son') · give him! (ወ- + 2ms imperative ሀብ + -ኦ '3ms him', ወሀቦ ወለተከ 'give him your daughter')
glossary.ወለሊሁኒ: ለሊሁ — and he himself also (ወ- + ለሊ 'self' + -ሁ '3ms' + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወለደት: ወለደ — she bore, gave birth (3fs perfect)
glossary.ወለደቶ: ወለደ — she bore him (3fs perfect ወለደት + -ኦ 'him', joined as ቶ)
glossary.ወልደ: ወልድ — son (noun, construct state 'son-of') · accusative 'a son' (ወለደት ወልደ 'she bore a son')
glossary.ወሐለዩ: ሐለየ — and they sang, chanted (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, ḥ-l-y; the verb's basic sense is 'think, meditate') (?)
glossary.ወሐፀናሆሙ: ሐፀነ — and they nursed them (ወ- + 3fp perfect ሐፀና, G, ḥ-ṣ-n + -ሆሙ '3mp them'; the two women)
glossary.ወመንግሥትሰ: መንግሥት — and as for the kingdom (ወ- + noun + emphatic -ሰ)
glossary.ወመጠዎ: መጠወ — and he delivered him, handed him over (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.ወሞቱ: ሞተ — and they died (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, m-w-t)
glossary.ወረሰይዎ: ረሰየ — and they made him, set him (ወ- + 3mp perfect + -ኦ '3ms him'; takes a predicate accusative 'as, to be')
glossary.ወሰመየቶ: ሰመየ — and she named him (ወ- + 3fs perfect + -ኦ '3ms him', joined as ቶ)
glossary.ወሰምሶንሰ: ሰምሶን — and as for Samson (ወ- + proper name + emphatic -ሰ)
glossary.ወሰርከ: ሰርክ — and evening (ወ- + noun, accusative used adverbially)
glossary.ወስመ: ስም — and the name of (ወ- + noun, construct)
glossary.ወቀተሎሙ: ቀተለ — and he killed them (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ወበሕይወቱሰ: ሕይወት — and in his life (ወ- + በ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his' + emphatic -ሰ)
glossary.ወበመንከሰ: መንከስ — and with the jawbone of (ወ- + በ- 'with' + noun, construct 'jawbone of') (?)
glossary.ወበበትር: በትር — and with a staff (ወ- + በ- 'with' + noun)
glossary.ወበእብን: እብን — and with stone (ወ- + በ- + እብን 'stone', noun)
glossary.ወበእንተዝ: በእንተዝ — and on this account (ወ- + preposition + demonstrative)
glossary.ወቤል: ቤል — and Bel (ወ- + proper name; a god)
glossary.ወቤተ: ቤት — and the house of (ወ- + noun, construct)
glossary.ወቦአ: ቦአ — and he entered (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, b-w-ʾ)
glossary.ወተረክበ: ተረክበ — and was found (ወ- + 3ms perfect, tä-stem passive of ረከበ 'find')
glossary.ወተዐደወ: ተዐደወ — and he transgressed (ወ- + 3ms perfect, tä-stem of ዐደወ 'cross over'; with an accusative, 'break a command')
glossary.ወተፈሥሑ: ተፈሥሐ — and they rejoiced (ወ- + 3mp perfect, tä-stem)
glossary.ወነበራ: ነበረ — and they lived, dwelt (ወ- + 3fp perfect, G, n-b-r; of two women)
glossary.ወአልቦን: አልቦ — and they have not, there is not to them (ወ- + አልቦ + -ን '3fp them')
glossary.ወአውሰበ: አውሰበ — and he married (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative of ወሰበ; of a man taking a wife)
glossary.ወአዕ: አዕኑግ — first part of a split word: ወአዕ + ኑገ = ወአዕኑገ 'and collars' (?); not a word by itself
glossary.ወአዖርዎ: አዖረ — and they blinded him (ወ- + 3mp perfect, causative of ዐወረ 'be blind' + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.ወአፍረሰ: አፍረሰ — and he pulled down, demolished (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative of ፈረሰ 'fall, collapse')
glossary.ወአፍቀርዋ: አፍቀረ — and they loved her (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect, causative; + -ኣ '3fs her')
glossary.ወኢትቅረቢ: ቀርበ — and do not approach (ወ- + ኢ- + 2fs jussive, G, q-r-b)
glossary.ወኢወይነ: ወይን — and not wine (ወ- + ኢ- + noun ወይን 'wine', accusative ወይነ)
glossary.ወኢያውስብ: አውሰበ — and let him not marry (ወ- + ኢ- + 3ms jussive, causative of ወሰበ; of a man taking a wife)
glossary.ወኢይብላዕ: በልዐ — and let him not eat (ወ- + ኢ- + 3ms jussive, G, b-l-ʿ)
glossary.ወእመሂ: እመ — and whether, or whether (ወ- 'and' + conjunction እመ + enclitic -ሂ)
glossary.ወከመ: ከመ — that, so that (conjunction; ወ- 'and') · and as (ወከመ ዝ 'and as this') · 'and like' before a noun (ወከመ ድምፀ አንበሳ 'and like the voice of a lion')
glossary.ወዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — and without (ወ- + preposition) · 'and before' + subjunctive (ወዘእንበለ ታጥብዎ 'and before she could nurse him')
glossary.ወዘከመ: ዘከመ — and how, in the way that (ወ- 'and' + ዘከመ, ዘ- + ከመ)
glossary.ወዘይነግሥ: ነግሠ — and who will reign (ወ- + ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G)
glossary.ወይቤላ: ይቤ — and he said to her (ወ- + 3ms perfect of defective ይቤ + -ላ '3fs to her') · masculine form where a woman speaks to her sister and ትቤላ is expected (ወይቤላ ዝንቱ ንዋየ አቡነ 'and she said to her: this property of our father') (?)
glossary.ወይብልዋ: ብህለ — and they will say to her, call her (ወ- + 3mp imperfect + -ዋ '3fs her', b-h-l)
glossary.ወይትዋነዩ: ተዋነየ — and they sport, make merry, play (ወ- + 3m pl imperfect, w-n-y)
glossary.ወይትፋቀራ: ተፋቀረ — and they loved one another (ወ- + 3fp imperfect, reciprocal tä-stem; Geʿez has no dual, the ending marks two women)
glossary.ወይከውን: ኮነ — and it will be (ወ- + 3ms imperf., k-w-n)
glossary.ወደሊላሰ: ደሊላ — and as for Delilah (ወ- + proper name + emphatic -ሰ)
glossary.ወደሊላኒ: ደሊላ — and Delilah also (ወ- + proper name + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወገብአት: ገብአ — she returned (3fs perfect, G, g-b-ʾ; ወ- 'and')
glossary.ወገነዩ: ገነየ — and they did homage, served (ወ- + 3mp perfect)
glossary.ወፍቅሮንሂ: ፍቅር — and their love also (ወ- + noun ፍቅር 'love' + -ሆን '3fp their' contracted to -ን + enclitic -ሂ 'also')
glossary.ወ፪፼: ፪፼ — and 20,000, spoken ወክልኤቱ ትእልፊት (wä-kəlʾetu təʾəlfit) 'and two ten-thousands, and twenty thousand' (ወ- 'and' between numerals; ፼ = 10,000) (?)
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors') · upon, on (ውስተ ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'upon their hips'; ውስተ መንበረ አቡሁ 'on his father's throne')
glossary.ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is')
glossary.ውእቱሰ: ውእቱ — as for him (3ms pronoun + emphatic -ሰ)
glossary.ዘርአ: ዘርእ — seed (construct 'seed of') · also 'seed' as sown grain, absolute (ዘርአ ወማእረረ 'seed(time) and harvest') · accusative 'offspring' (ይሁበኒ እግዚኣብሔር ዘርአ 'may God give me offspring') · in apposition to ውሉድ: 'offspring' (አልቦውሉደ ዘርአ 'no child, no seed')
glossary.ዘተርፈ: ተረፈ — who remained (ዘ- + 3ms perfect, G, t-r-f)
glossary.ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered') · conjunction 'before' + subjunctive (ዘእንበለ ይስአሉ አበዊነ ንጉሠ 'before our fathers asked for a king') (?)
glossary.ዘእንበሌኪ: ዘእንበለ — apart from you, besides you (preposition, stem ዘእንበሌ- + -ኪ '2fs you')
glossary.ዘወፅአ: ወፅአ — that which went out (ዘ- 'which' + 3ms perfect, G, w-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ዘያነሥኦ: አንሥአ — who raises him (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, causative of ንሥአ 'rise' + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.ዘይትወለድ: ተወልደ — who is born (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect, tä-stem of ወለደ) · 'that which is born' (neuter, ዘ- 'that which')
glossary.ዘዲባጋት: ዲባጋት — of brocades (ዘ- 'of' + plural noun, perhaps from Persian dībā 'silk brocade') (?)
glossary.ይብሉ: ብህለ — they say (3mp subjunctive/imperfect, after እንዘ 'saying') · 'let them say, let them call' (3mp jussive, ሎሙሰ ይብሉ አማልክቲሆሙ 'as for them, let them call them their gods')
glossary.ይእቲ: ይእቲ — she/it is (fem. pron.) · 'I am she' predicate (አነ ይእቲ አቡከ 'I am she, your father') · 'that' (fem. demonstrative, ይእቲ ሠሉስ ዕለት 'that third day') · 'she' restating the subject, a resumptive pronoun before a noun (ይእቲ ባሕርይ 'she, the pearl')
glossary.ይኩን: ኮነ — let him be (3m sg jussive, k-w-n) · let it be (3ms jussive, here after ዘእንበለ 'except': ዘእንበለ ይኩን ቆዐ ሠርጸ ጽጌ 'except it be that the tendril put forth blossom') (?)
glossary.ደቂቀ: ደቂቅ — sons, children (plural ደቂቅ, construct 'sons of')
glossary.ፅኑሳት: ፅኑስ — pregnant (adjective, fem. plural; of ፀንሰ 'conceive') (?)
glossary.ፅንስት: ፅንስት — pregnant (adjective, fem. sg.; of ፀንሰ 'conceive')
glossary.ፈጥረት: ፍጥረት — creation, creature (noun; written ፈጥረት here); said here of a people or race (?)
glossary.ፍ: ፍቅር — first part of a split word: ፍ + ቅሮን = ፍቅሮን 'their love' (see ወፍቅሮንሂ); not a word by itself
glossary.፬: ፬ — 4, spoken አርባዕቱ (ʾarbaʿtu) 'four'; chapter number (numeral) · also a counted number 'four' (ውስተ ፬ መሳምክቲሃ 'in her four supports'; spoken አርባዕ ʾarbaʿ before a feminine plural, አርባዕቱ with a masculine)
glossary.፭: ፭ — 5, spoken ኀምስቱ (ḫaməstu) 'five'; chapter number (numeral) · also a counted number 'five' (፭ ስሑታን 'five erring ones'; spoken ኀምስቱ before a masculine) · spoken ኀምስ (ḫaməs) before a feminine noun (፭ ዓመተ 'five years')
glossary.፸፼: ፸፼ — 700,000, spoken ሰብዓ ትእልፊት (säbʿa təʾəlfit) 'seventy ten-thousands, seven hundred thousand' (numeral; ፼ = 10,000)
